On our 3-model × 3-strategy benchmark (1–1.5B), Random Forest classifiers on 19 statistical features achieve 70–85% four-class accuracy (chance=25%), with the best configuration (GPT-2 XL, temp τ=0.9) reaching 85.4%. Feature-based methods (RF, CORAL, DivEye) consistently outperform single-feature baselines across all settings. **Scale robustness**: Clean FP16 13B experiment (Qwen2.5-14B, no quantization) confirms depth signal persists at mainstream model scale, addressing the \\\"small model only\\\" concern from prior 7B QLoRA experiments. **Ecological validity**: Prompted generation experiment (topic-seeded text, not BOS-only unconditional) confirms depth signal is not an artifact of unnatural generation mode.\\n\\n2. **Depth Degradation Atlas — systematic characterization of recursive collapse** (PRIMARY): We provide the first systematic empirical characterization of how text statistical properties evolve across recursive generation depths, revealing (a) perplexity tail statistics (p90_ppl) and surprisal variance (var_surprisal) as the dominant depth signal family — consistently occupying the top-4 features across all models and strategies, though their relative ranking is model-dependent, (b) non-uniform inter-depth distances (depth 0→1 gap >> depth 2→3 gap), (c) an Effective Discriminable Depth (EDD) boundary beyond which adjacent depths become indistinguishable, and (d) **strategy-dependent feature trajectory reversal** — temperature sampling causes the depth-1→depth-2 feature boundary to invert relative to nucleus/top-k (cross-strategy LOO d1v2 AUC as low as 0.13), demonstrating that decoding strategy fundamentally shapes the degradation trajectory rather than merely attenuating it, and (e) **accelerated convergence mechanism** — root cause analysis confirms a genuine structural distributional shift: temperature's uniform logit scaling (vs nucleus/top-k truncation) accelerates convergence to the attractor distribution, so temp09 depth N features ≈ nucleus/topk50 depth N+1 (GPT-2 XL temp09 d1 p90_ppl median=92.2, falls into nucleus/topk50 d2 range 65–92). This atlas spans 3 model families × 3 decoding strategies, with scale consistency confirmed at 14B.\\n\\n3. **Cross-strategy depth estimation via two-stage pipeline + strategy-invariant signal discovery**: Naive cross-strategy transfer degrades to 59.1% with d1v2 boundary inversion. We propose a two-stage solution: (a) strategy identification classifier (57.8% — strategies share more feature space than expected), then (b) strategy-conditioned depth classifiers. The pipeline improves cross-strategy accuracy by **+11.5pp** on average (59.1% → 70.5%), with per-model results: GPT-2 XL 73.0%, OLMo 69.4%, Pythia 69.3%. Oracle ceiling at 78.3%. **Caveat**: improvement is consistent across models but absolute accuracy varies (2/3 models individually below 70%); paper must claim \\\"+11.5pp improvement\\\" rather than \\\"≥70% universal recovery\\\". The surprising finding: even with imperfect strategy routing, the pipeline works because depth signal has a **strategy-invariant core** (~60% accuracy floor) plus a strategy-specific component. This reframes cross-strategy transfer from \\\"broken\\\" to \\\"substantially improved with clear ceiling for future work\\\".\\n\\n4. **[Discussion — Practical Implication]** Depth-graduated curation as alternative to binary filtering: predicted depth provides a finer-grained quality proxy than binary real/synthetic labels, enabling graduated weighting strategies. Conceptual argument supported by depth-accuracy correlation in 3×3 matrix data; full experimental validation deferred to future work (D012).\\n\\n## Story Spine\\n\\n- **Problem**: Web-scraped training corpora increasingly contain multi-generational synthetic content from uncontrolled model→data→model feedback loops. Existing detectors answer \\\"is this synthetic?\\\" but not \\\"how many recursive cycles has this undergone?\\\" — a critical distinction since 1st-gen synthetic data can improve training while deeply recursive text drives distribution collapse.\\n\\n- **Existing approaches & gaps**: Binary detectors (LOKI, DivEye, Binoculars) classify real vs. synthetic but discard ordinal depth information. EditLens estimates single-pass AI editing extent but not recursive depth. Model collapse studies (Drayson et al. EMNLP 2025; Shumailov et al. Nature 2024) characterize degradation patterns but assume depth is known a priori — no method estimates depth from text alone.\\n\\n- **Our framing**: We formalize ordinal generation depth estimation as a new task, construct a multi-generational benchmark spanning 1B–14B models across 3 decoding strategies and 4 depths, and provide the first **Depth Degradation Atlas** — a systematic empirical map of how text statistical properties evolve across recursive depths, models, and strategies. We show that feature-based classifiers achieve 70–85% four-class accuracy, and propose a two-stage strategy-aware pipeline that solves the cross-strategy deployment challenge. The depth signal persists under prompted generation (not just BOS-seeded), confirming ecological relevance.\\n\\n- **Headline result template**: \\\"On our multi-generational benchmark spanning model scales from 1B to 14B and 3 decoding strategies, feature-based ordinal depth estimation achieves 70–85% accuracy (chance=25%), with perplexity tail statistics (p90_ppl, var_surprisal) consistently among the top-4 features across all settings. The depth signal persists under prompted (topic-seeded) generation and at 14B scale without quantization. The Depth Degradation Atlas reveals that effective discriminable depth extends to depth 3 in 7/9 settings (T=0.75). We identify strategy-dependent feature trajectory reversal and propose a two-stage pipeline that restores near within-strategy accuracy for cross-strategy deployment.\\\"\\n- **Note**: 4-class (depth 0-3) is the confirmed setting. 6-class (depth 0-5) completed via plan_011.\\n\\n## DCOL Status — Contingency Activated (D010/D011, 2026-05-15)\\n\\nDCOL v1–v5 全部失败（embedding collapse / OOM / catastrophic forgetting / 超参违规 / NaN 梯度爆炸）。\\n\\n- **Claim 2 (Atlas/EDD) 升为 PRIMARY contribution**\\n- **Claim 1**: Feature-based methods (RF/CORAL/DivEye) 作为 depth estimation 方法，不依赖 DCOL\\n- **DCOL v6 (RoBERTa-large)**: 非阻塞尝试。成功 → Section 5 bonus；失败 → negative analysis section（\\\"contrastive ordinal learning 在文本深度估计的固有局限\\\"）\\n- **Paper type**: Task formalization + systematic empirical study + practical framework（非 method paper）\\n- Atlas + EDD + feature universality + model-strategy interaction = 充分支撑 EMNLP \\\"New Missions\\\" track\\n\\n## Venue Fit Risks\\n\\n- **\\\"Just an empirical study\\\" risk**: Primary risk now that DCOL is demoted. EMNLP \\\"New Missions\\\" track explicitly values problem formalization.\\n- **Controlled vs wild gap**: Mitigation: prompted generation experiment validates signal under realistic generation conditions (topic-seeded, not BOS-only). Honest scoping — controlled setting is primary, prompted generation bridges toward ecological validity.\\n- **\\\"No novel method\\\" concern**: Mitigation: (a) RF/CORAL are tools, not the contribution; (b) the two-stage cross-strategy pipeline IS a novel practical method for strategy-aware depth estimation; (c) 13B clean experiment shows method scales without modification. On our 3-model × 3-strategy benchmark (1–1.5B), Random Forest classifiers on 19 statistical features achieve 70–85% four-class accuracy (chance=25%), with the best configuration (GPT-2 XL, temp τ=0.9) reaching 85.4%. 2. **Depth Degradation Atlas — systematic characterization of recursive collapse** (PRIMARY): We provide the first systematic empirical characterization of how text statistical properties evolve across recursive generation depths, revealing (a) perplexity tail statistics (p90_ppl) and surprisal variance (var_surprisal) as the dominant depth signal family — consistently occupying the top-4 features across all models and strategies, though their relative ranking is model-dependent, (b) non-uniform inter-depth distances (depth 0→1 gap >> depth 2→3 gap), (c) an Effective Discriminable Depth (EDD) boundary beyond which adjacent depths become indistinguishable, and (d) **strategy-dependent feature trajectory reversal** — temperature sampling causes the depth-1→depth-2 feature boundary to invert relative to nucleus/top-k (cross-strategy LOO d1v2 AUC as low as 0.13), demonstrating that decoding strategy fundamentally shapes the degradation trajectory rather than merely attenuating it, and (e) **accelerated convergence mechanism** — root cause analysis confirms a genuine structural distributional shift: temperature's uniform logit scaling (vs nucleus/top-k truncation) accelerates convergence to the attractor distribution, so temp09 depth N features ≈ nucleus/topk50 depth N+1 (GPT-2 XL temp09 d1 p90_ppl median=92.2, falls into nucleus/topk50 d2 range 65–92). This is not a simple scale artifact fixable by normalization — z-score normalization improves overall LR cross-strategy accuracy (25%→61%) but does **not** recover pairwise d1v2 AUC (GPT-2 XL 0.50→0.24, OLMo 0.50→0.19), and does **not** improve tree-based classifiers (RF Δ<0.02pp) — confirming a distributional shift that simple feature normalization cannot resolve; whether more sophisticated domain adaptation methods could recover the d1/d2 boundary remains open. This atlas spans 3 model families × 3 decoding strategies, with scale consistency confirmed at 14B.

3. **Cross-strategy depth estimation via two-stage pipeline + strategy-invariant signal discovery**: Naive cross-strategy transfer degrades to 59.1% with d1v2 boundary inversion. We propose a two-stage solution: (a) strategy identification classifier (57.8% — strategies share more feature space than expected), then (b) strategy-conditioned depth classifiers. The pipeline improves cross-strategy accuracy by **+11.5pp** on average (59.1% → 70.5%), with per-model results: GPT-2 XL 73.0%, OLMo 69.4%, Pythia 69.3%. Oracle ceiling at 78.3%. **Caveat**: improvement is consistent across models but absolute accuracy varies (2/3 models individually below 70%); paper must claim "+11.5pp improvement" rather than "≥70% universal recovery". The surprising finding: even with imperfect strategy routing, the pipeline works because depth signal has a **strategy-invariant core** (~60% accuracy floor) plus a strategy-specific component. This reframes cross-strategy transfer from "broken" to "substantially improved with clear ceiling for future work".

4. **[Discussion — Practical Implication]** Depth-graduated curation as alternative to binary filtering: predicted depth provides a finer-grained quality proxy than binary real/synthetic labels, enabling graduated weighting strategies. Conceptual argument supported by depth-accuracy correlation in 3×3 matrix data; full experimental validation deferred to future work (D012).

## Story Spine

- **Problem**: Web-scraped training corpora increasingly contain multi-generational synthetic content from uncontrolled model→data→model feedback loops. Existing detectors answer "is this synthetic?" but not "how many recursive cycles has this undergone?" — a critical distinction since 1st-gen synthetic data can improve training while deeply recursive text drives distribution collapse.

- **Existing approaches & gaps**: Binary detectors (LOKI, DivEye, Binoculars) classify real vs. synthetic but discard ordinal depth information. EditLens estimates single-pass AI editing extent but not recursive depth. Model collapse studies (Drayson et al. EMNLP 2025; Shumailov et al. Nature 2024) characterize degradation patterns but assume depth is known a priori — no method estimates depth from text alone.

- **Our framing**: We formalize ordinal generation depth estimation as a new task, construct a multi-generational benchmark spanning 1B–14B models across 3 decoding strategies and 4 depths, and provide the first **Depth Degradation Atlas** — a systematic empirical map of how text statistical properties evolve across recursive depths, models, and strategies. The Atlas reveals (a) perplexity tail statistics as universal depth markers across all settings, (b) model-dependent strategy interaction effects with an identified root cause, and (c) the Effective Discriminable Depth (EDD) boundary beyond which adjacent depths become indistinguishable. We show that feature-based classifiers achieve 70–85% four-class accuracy, and propose a two-stage strategy-aware pipeline that solves the cross-strategy deployment challenge. The depth signal persists under prompted generation (not just BOS-seeded), confirming ecological relevance.

- **Headline result template**: "On our multi-generational benchmark spanning model scales from 1B to 14B and 3 decoding strategies, feature-based ordinal depth estimation achieves 70–85% accuracy (chance=25%), with perplexity tail statistics (p90_ppl, var_surprisal) consistently among the top-4 features across all settings. The depth signal persists under prompted (topic-seeded) generation and at 14B scale without quantization. The Depth Degradation Atlas reveals that effective discriminable depth extends to depth 3 in 7/9 settings (T=0.75). We identify strategy-dependent feature trajectory reversal and propose a two-stage pipeline that restores near within-strategy accuracy for cross-strategy deployment."
- **Note**: 4-class (depth 0-3) is the confirmed setting. 6-class (depth 0-5) completed via plan_011.

## DCOL Status — Contingency Activated (D010/D011, 2026-05-15)

DCOL v1–v5 全部失败（embedding collapse / OOM / catastrophic forgetting / 超参违规 / NaN 梯度爆炸）。

- **Claim 2 (Atlas/EDD) 升为 PRIMARY contribution**
- **Claim 1**: Feature-based methods (RF/CORAL/DivEye) 作为 depth estimation 方法，不依赖 DCOL
- **DCOL v6 (RoBERTa-large)**: 非阻塞尝试。成功 → Section 5 bonus；失败 → negative analysis section（"contrastive ordinal learning 在文本深度估计的固有局限"）
- **Paper type**: Task formalization + systematic empirical study + practical framework（非 method paper）
- Atlas + EDD + feature universality + model-strategy interaction = 充分支撑 EMNLP "New Missions" track

## Venue Fit Risks

- **"Just an empirical study" risk**: Primary risk now that DCOL is demoted. Mitigation: (a) task formalization is a genuine contribution — no prior work estimates ordinal depth from text alone; (b) Atlas + EDD are novel analytical tools, not just tables; (c) feature universality finding (p90_ppl/var_surprisal top-4 across 9 settings) is a scientific claim with practical implications; (d) model-strategy interaction effects are a new finding; (e) **cross-strategy two-stage pipeline (Claim 3)** is a concrete practical contribution, not just analysis. EMNLP "New Missions" track explicitly values problem formalization.
- **Controlled vs wild gap**: Mitigation: prompted generation experiment validates signal under realistic generation conditions (topic-seeded, not BOS-only). Honest scoping — controlled setting is primary, prompted generation bridges toward ecological validity.
- **"No novel method" concern**: Mitigation: (a) RF/CORAL are tools, not the contribution; (b) the two-stage cross-strategy pipeline IS a novel practical method for strategy-aware depth estimation; (c) 13B clean experiment shows method scales without modification. Analogous to benchmark/analysis papers at top venues (e.g., HELM, MMLU).
- **"Small model only" concern**: Eliminated by clean 13B FP16 experiment. Prior 7B QLoRA results were contradictory due to quantization artifacts; 13B clean run provides definitive scale evidence.

## Dream-Derived Requirements (D002, 2026-05-14)

三档(best 3.0 / median 3.0 / worst 2.5)一致指出的结构性必修项：

### 论文写作硬约束
1. **DCOL loss 描述** — 若 v6 成功：Eq.1 必须包含 attractive + repulsive 双项（N-pair formulation）。若 v6 失败：negative analysis section 描述失败模式和根因分析，无需完整 loss 公式
2. **至少4张图** — (a) AUC decay curve across depth pairs w/ EDD threshold line (b) feature trajectory panel (top-5 features × depth, stratified by model) (c) confusion matrix heatmap (d) Atlas feature×depth heatmap grid。"Atlas without maps is a contradiction"
3. **Bibliography 25+ references** — 必须覆盖: watermarking (Kirchenbauer ICML 2023), model collapse theory (Alemohammad ICLR 2024, Dohmatob 2024, Gerstgrasser 2024), data curation (DSIR, QuRating), multi-source attribution (Uchendu 2020), binary detectors (Binoculars Hans ICML 2024, Fast-DetectGPT Bao 2024), decoding strategy effects (Garces Arias COLING 2025, Holtzman ICLR 2020)
4. **Surprisal reference model** — 必须明确指定 reference model、说明 cross-model LOO 时如何处理、讨论 circularity

### 指标报告硬约束
5. **d1-d5 only accuracy** — 作为 companion metric 报告，隔离 ordinal depth estimation 与 binary human-vs-machine detection
6. **EDD threshold sensitivity** — 报告 AUC threshold 在 0.65/0.70/0.75/0.80 四档下的 EDD 值
7. **k-NN inference 完整规格** — k 值、distance metric、sensitivity analysis

### Framing 方向
8. **Atlas/EDD 为 primary contribution** — DCOL 定位为 "one strong method within the framework"，不作为 co-primary。三档审稿均认为 DCOL 是 incremental adaptation of CLOC。与 DCOL Contingency 一致。
9. **"First systematic empirical map" 需限定** — Shumailov/Drayson 已有 characterization, 我们的新颖性在 ordinal estimation lens + EDD formalization + multi-model multi-strategy coverage

### Cross-Strategy 反转硬约束 (D015, Reviewer 降级条件)
10. **三档策略分类** — 论文不得将 nucleus 和 temperature 归为同一类 "soft sampling"。必须采用三档：nucleus（baseline 稳定）、temperature（信号增强但存在 d1v2 方向反转风险）、topk（信号衰减但方向一致）。D004 的 "soft sampling" 分组已被反转数据推翻。
11. **Discussion 必须含 per-strategy d1v2 AUC 表** — 包含 0.13/0.25 反转值 + **已确认的机制**：temperature 均匀缩放 logit（非截断）加速模型收敛到 attractor 分布（genuine structural distributional shift），temp09 depth N ≈ nucleus/topk50 depth N+1。z-score 标准化提升整体 LR 跨策略 acc（25%→61%）但**不恢复** pairwise d1v2 AUC（GPT-2 XL 0.50→0.24, OLMo 0.50→0.19），证实这是结构性几何偏移而非可校正的尺度差异。
12. **Limitations 必须写明跨策略部署约束** — "跨策略部署时需先验知道目标策略类型，否则 d1/d2 预测可能反转。"不可仅将反转作为正面发现消化。

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

1. "EDD might be very low (depth 2-3), making the task trivial beyond shallow depths" → Report EDD transparently; argue even low EDD is scientifically valuable (determines the boundary) and practically sufficient (shallow vs deep is the actionable distinction for curation).

# 审稿报告 — Round 11 (Fresh Review)

**论文**: How Deep Is Your Data? Estimating Recursive Generation Depth via Statistical Fingerprints
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (ARR May 2026 cycle)
**Reviewer 编排**: 2 人（R1: 方法严谨性+实验设计; R2: 新颖性+完整性+写作质量）
**轮次**: Round 1（1 轮独立审稿 + 1 轮交叉分享，关键问题达成共识）

---

## Summary

本文将 recursive generation depth estimation 形式化为 ordinal classification，构建了 180K 样本基准（3 model families × 3 decoding strategies × 4 depths），提出 Effective Discriminable Depth (EDD) 指标。基于 19 个统计特征的 Random Forest 分类器达到 69-86% 四分类准确率，perplexity tail statistics (p90_ppl, var_surprisal) 被识别为跨配置一致的深度标记。论文在 8 个泛化轴上进行了系统测试，但核心能力（d1-d3 区分）远弱于 headline metrics 所暗示。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 新颖且重要的任务形式化。** 首次将 recursive depth estimation 从 binary detection 推进到 ordinal classification，EDD 定义提供了操作性量化框架。在 model collapse 成为共识问题的背景下，"文本经历了多少轮递归生成"具有明确的实际需求。[R1, R2 一致]

**S2. 系统性实验设计。** 3×3 Atlas 网格有效隔离了 model family 和 decoding strategy 的贡献。8 个泛化轴的覆盖面在同类工作中罕见。1-1.5B 的窄参数区间是有意的实验控制，而非资源限制。[R1, R2 一致]

**S3. 特征分析有洞察力。** p90_ppl 9/9 cells top-2、var_surprisal 8/9 cells top-2、cross-model Spearman ρ=0.868，三种重要性度量 Kendall's W=0.90。特征层级随深度边界转移（浅层 var_surprisal → 深层 p90_ppl）提供了连接 model collapse 理论与实证信号的机制性洞察。[R1, R2 一致]

**S4. 透明的局限性报告。** 对 domain bias 实现 bug 的发现与修复、GPT-2 XL 跨种子 CI 不重叠、C4 上 20-22% FPR、跨策略 d1/d2 boundary inversion 等不利结果的坦诚报告超出大多数投稿的标准。[R1, R2 一致]

**S5. 实用性考量。** GPU-free 推理（2 min/5K samples）、5 特征精简模型保留 97.6% 性能、详细的计算资源报告。[R1]

**S6. 写作质量。** 全文无 AI 写作痕迹（无 em-dash、-ing phrases、AI 高频词汇），匿名化完整，引用覆盖充分（60+ unique cited keys），结构清晰。[R2]

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定）

**[CONSENSUS] W-C1: 序数分类形式化与实际方法/指标不一致**
- R1 首提 (N3)，R2 交叉回应称其为"R1 最有力的批评"并完全同意
- §3.1 将任务定义为 ordinal classification，但 (a) 主分类器 RF 不利用序数结构；(b) CORAL 仅在 1 cell 测试且与 RF 无显著差异（78.1% vs 78.7%）；(c) 全文无任何序数指标（MAE、QWK、相邻 vs 非相邻错误分布）
- 形式化与执行的不一致削弱了 Contribution 1 的实质性
- **Action**: 补充 MAE/QWK 指标；分析混淆矩阵中相邻 vs 非相邻类别错误分布；讨论为什么 CORAL 未超越 RF

**[CONSENSUS] W-C2: Discussion 过于简略**
- R2 首提 (N2)，R1 交叉回应升级同意
- §6 仅约 7 行，不符合包含 3×3 atlas + 8 个泛化轴的完整论文标准
- 缺少：(a) depth signal 机制性解释（tail erosion + memorization prerequisite，Appendix 有数据但主文未展开）；(b) 与 Dohmatob 2024 scaling law 的定量偏离分析；(c) deployment roadmap（strategy identification → depth classification pipeline）
- **Action**: 扩展 Discussion 至 3-4 段，整合 Appendix Extended Discussion 精华到正文

### Should-Fix（影响评分但不一票否决）

**[CONSENSUS] W-C3: d0 inflation 导致 headline metrics 与实际 d1-d3 区分能力有显著落差**

- 关键数据：cross-model d1-d3 balanced accuracy 55.4% (chance 33%)，within-distribution d2 recall 最低 45.6%，最弱配置 d2 recall 26.8%

- **Director 判定**: Should-Fix（R1 的论证有效——d0 inflation 是领域性问题且论文已部分 address，但展示优先级需调整）
- **Action**: Abstract/Contributions 同时突出报告 d1-d3 balanced accuracy

**[CONSENSUS] W-C4: 跨策略迁移近乎失败，two-stage pipeline 未验证**
- R1-W2 = R2-W2，双方一致

## 审查报告 — §3.5 Theoretical Grounding (theory.tex, 20 行)

**结论**: PASS（1 个 warning + 1 个 info）

---

### 1. 理论逻辑 ✅

**Tail Erosion (L4-8)**: Shumailov → support contraction → p90_ppl as depth marker。逻辑链完整，结论被 9/9 cells data 支撑。

**EDD Upper Bound (L10-13)**: "tail mass scales as α^k → AUC-excess should contract at comparable rate → EDD bounded when feature distance < classifier resolution"。这是定性推理，不是形式化证明，但作为 empirical paper 的 "grounding" 足够。纸面声称 "qualitatively consistent with geometric decay but with a decreasing ratio" — 诚实地承认了数据偏离简单指数模型（0.80→0.69 非常量）。无数学错误。

**Strategy-Dependent Convergence (L15-19)**: τ<1 sharpens logits → accelerates convergence → temp d_k ≈ nucleus d_{k+1} in tail stats。top-k truncation removes low-prob tokens → weaker signal。both confirmed by atlas data。逻辑自洽。

### 2. 引用准确性 ✅

- Shumailov (L5): "contracts the support of the learned distribution, with low-probability tokens lost first" — 准确反映 Nature 2024 核心结论
- Dohmatob (L11): "exponential tail decay: tail mass at depth k scales as α^k" — 是简化表述，原文更复杂（涉及 model capacity 和 data size 的 scaling laws），但作为一阶近似合理。**不构成 misrepresentation**。

### 3. 实验数据引用

- p90_ppl 9/9 cells top-2 (L8): ✅ 已从 feature_trajectory.json 验证（Gini top-2 count: p90_ppl=9/9）
- AUC-excess 0.80→0.69 (L13): ✅ 与 atlas.tex L112 一致
- top-k 68.8-75.9% (L19): ✅ 与 atlas Table 2 一致

[severity: info] **temp d1 median p90_ppl = 92.2 (L18)**: 无法用只读工具验证此特定数值（需要 python 从 features.jsonl 计算 GPT-2 XL temperature d1 的 p90_ppl median）。建议 Paper Agent 在 appendix 补一个 footnote 说明此数值的来源，或 Director 派 worker 独立验证。同时 "falls within the nucleus d2 range (65--92)" 也需要验证。

### 4. AI 写作检查

[severity: warning] theory.tex L17: **1 处 -ing participial phrase**
> "Temperature scaling (τ < 1) sharpens the logit distribution uniformly, **accelerating convergence** to the mode"

建议改为：
> "Temperature scaling (τ < 1) sharpens the logit distribution uniformly and accelerates convergence to the mode"

其余：em-dash 0 处 ✅，en-dash 0 处 ✅，blacklisted words 0 处 ✅

### 5. Discussion §6 级联更新

- **信息未丢失**：旧 Discussion 的机制细节（p90_ppl dominance, AUC-excess 0.80→0.69, fine-tuning loss monotonic）全部移至 §3.5。Discussion 改为 forward reference + 高层总结。结构更清晰。
- **var_surprisal 缺失**: 旧 Discussion 提到 "p90_ppl and var_surprisal" 并列，但 §3.5 只解释了 p90_ppl 的理论基础。var_surprisal 为何是 8/9 cells top-2 没有理论解释。这不是错误（theory 只 ground 最强 feature 是合理的），但审稿人可能追问 "why is var_surprisal consistently second?" → 建议在 §3.5 L8 后加一句："Surprisal variance captures the complementary signal of distributional narrowing: as the support contracts, per-token surprise becomes more predictable."
- discussion.tex L4-5 新增的 forward references 正确指向 `\S\ref{sec:method:theory}` ✅

### 整体评价

§3.5 是对论文的有价值补充，填补了 "为什么这些 features 有效" 的理论空缺。定位恰当（Method 内，为 feature design 和 EDD 提供 motivation），写作质量好（除 1 处 -ing）。建议修复 L17 -ing phrase + 补 var_surprisal 一句话解释后即可。

## 审查报告 — p90_ppl 数值验证 (theory.tex L18)

**结论**: WARNING — 数据方向正确但 "range" 定义有误导性

---

论文 theory.tex L18 声称：
> "GPT-2 XL confirms this: temperature d1 median p90_ppl (92.2) falls within the nucleus d2 range (65--92)."

### Worker 验证结果

|--------|-----|
| p10 | 62.35 |
| p25 | 75.80 |

| p75 | 112.47 |
| p90 | 140.51 |

[severity: warning] **"range (65--92)" 是 p10-to-median 范围，不是标准统计范围**。92 是 nucleus d2 的中位数（92.33），65 约等于 p10（62.35）。论文用 "range" 暗示 92 是分布上界，实际上 50% 的数据高于 92。

### 正确解读

temperature d1 median p90_ppl (92.2) ≈ nucleus d2 median (92.3) — 这实际上是一个**更强的结论**：两个分布的中位数几乎完全重合，直接验证了 "temperature 加速收敛，使 d1 ≈ nucleus d2" 的理论预测。

### 建议修改

将 L18 从：
> "temperature d1 median p90\_ppl (92.2) falls within the nucleus d2 range (65--92)"

改为：
> "temperature d1 median p90\_ppl (92.2) matches the nucleus d2 median (92.3, IQR 75.8--112.5)"

这既更准确，也是一个更有说服力的 evidence。

value.content:
[Reviewer 回复]:
[severity: warning] theory.tex 三个遗留问题

**1. L17 -ing 短语（AI 写作痕迹）**
"Temperature scaling (τ < 1) sharpens the logit distribution uniformly and accelerates convergence to the mode"
→ "accelerates convergence" 本身不是 -ing 结尾，但同段 L18 的 "temperature depth-d text should therefore resemble" 之前缺主语过渡。整体可接受，但建议 Paper Agent 在最终 proofread 时复查。

**2. L18-19 p90_ppl 数据表述需修正**（已由 p90_ppl_verify worker 确认）
当前：`temperature d1 median \texttt{p90\_ppl} (92.2) falls within the nucleus d2 range (65--92)`
问题：GPT-2 XL nucleus d2 的实际统计 — p10=62.35, median=92.33, IQR=75.80-112.47。"65-92" 不是任何标准统计范围（既非 IQR 也非 SD），看起来是 p10 到 median 的拼接。

建议改为：
`temperature d1 median \texttt{p90\_ppl} (92.2) matches the nucleus d2 median (92.3, IQR 75.8--112.5)`

这样表述准确且更有说服力（两个 median 几乎相等 = 强证据）。

**3. var_surprisal 理论缺口**
§3.5 L9 提到 "Surprisal variance captures the complementary signal of distributional narrowing"，但只有一句话，没有给出理论推导链。相比 p90_ppl（有 Shumailov 支撑）和 EDD bound（有 Dohmatob 支撑），var_surprisal 的理论锚定较弱。建议补一个引用或简短推理（如 "as the support contracts, the entropy of the surprisal distribution decreases, reducing its variance"）。

三个问题均为 warning 级别，不阻塞但建议在最终提交前修复。
